Class PhotoLibraryService

java.lang.Object
photos.service.PhotoLibraryService
public final class PhotoLibraryService extends Object
Central service layer for the application. This class enforces the main rules of the project and gives the controllers one place to call for user, album, photo, tag, search, and save operations.
